ratios.facility: 2024 Credit Agreement (revolving credit facility and delayed draw Term Loan A)
ratios.quote: The 2024 Credit Agreement contains a financial covenant that does not permit the Company to allow its net leverage ratio to exceed, in the case of any fiscal quarter ending on or following March 30, 2025, 3.25 to 1.00 or, if the Company consummates any material acquisition, then the Company’s net leverage ratio shall not exceed 3.75 to 1.00 for the applicable fiscal quarter in which such acquisition is consummated and the three consecutive fiscal quarters thereafter.

ratios.facility: 2024 Credit Agreement (revolving credit facility and delayed draw Term Loan A)
ratios.quote: The Company is also required to maintain a minimum interest coverage ratio of 3.00 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: No actual ratio values are disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance with all debt covenants as of September 27, 2026 and December 28, 2025. The 3.75x net leverage limit for Q3 2026 is inferred: the American Woodmark Merger (effective May 28, 2026) is deemed a material acquisition, which steps the base 3.25x limit up to 3.75x for the acquisition quarter and the three following quarters. The temporary Second Amendment thresholds (4.00x net leverage for Q2/Q3 2026 and 2.75x minimum interest coverage) ceased to apply on the merger effective date, so the original 3.00x minimum interest coverage applies. Net leverage-based pricing grids for interest margins and commitment fees are excluded.
